3. Sightline analysis

Center gaze ray

Direct sun on window (year)
15th of each month, 06:30–19:30, 15-min steps, at the selected window & floor. Amber = direct sun (brighter = more head-on); rose = sun in front but blocked by a building; slate = sun behind the facade. Tap a cell to set date & time. Plan: sun path (Jun 21 / Mar 20 / Dec 21 + selected date) around the viewer.
Light & heat in room
Clear-sky model (real Singapore skies often cloudier). VSC = sky visible from window centre (CIE overcast); ADF = average daylight factor (BRE). Sun patch drawn on floor/back wall in Room interior view. Reveals/ledges not modelled.
Daylight over the day vs
Indoor average lux (room average, log scale), 06:30–19:30, selected room/floor/glass. Amber = selected date, sky blue = compare date (solid = clear sky, dashed = overcast sky: ADF × CIE overcast 300+21000·sin el). ≥300 lx = enough to work without lights; ≥3000 lx = glare/heat risk. Tap to set time.
Landmarks (7 samples each • tap to aim)
Geo frame: URA Master Plan 2025 land use (data.gov.sg), OSM buildings, MP2025 HDB footprints. Origin = TRPF parcel centroid (1.29682N, 103.87826E). Trees: parks/open space (22m grid), roadside (16m both sides), TRPF lawn (procedural, not occluders). Clouds: fixed fair-weather cumulus field. Room interior: 4-Room Type 1 dims, 2.6m ceiling, W1 0.55m parapet to 2.2m head, charcoal casement frame, clear glass. Roads: OSM motorway–tertiary; bridges/viaducts as decks (≈7.5m per OSM layer; Benjamin Sheares Bridge 16m approach / 28m main span), piers every 35m; tunnels (KPE, MCE) omitted. Heights: OSM height/levels where tagged; known CBD towers overridden; untagged estimated from parcel GPR (marked est.). New HDB from MP2025 footprints, storeys ≈ GPR×8. TRPF blocks traced from HDB floor plans, placed via the site plan fitted to the URA parcel (0.225 m/px). Marina East parcels are “subject to detailed planning”: defaults follow Marina South GLS precedent (GPR 5.6, 30-storey high-rise zone, 10-storey frontage, ~70% net site); layout synthetic, all sliders unclamped.
